# GraphicsBuffer <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

</div>


```blitzbasic
GraphicsBuffer:Int32
```

**Returns:** The handle of the current buffer.

## Description

Returns the buffer that drawing commands currently draw to, which is the one that the last [SetBuffer](SetBuffer) chose. Use it to remember the target and go back to it later.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local img = CreateImage(32, 32)
Local old = GraphicsBuffer()
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img)
Color 255, 255, 0
Rect 0, 0, 32, 32, 1
SetBuffer old
Cls
DrawImage img, 100, 100
Flip
WaitKey
```
